_comment: Generated from the ciphersuite and Web Crypto directly, not through the module. Not regenerable once any client has written a v1 envelope. See the README under "Regenerating the fixture" and the hash pin in golden-envelope.test.ts.

No client had written an envelope. Regenerated again 2026-10-15 during FXA-14742 with hpke 1.1.3 when pkR, enc and ct were bound into the skR wrap's aad; prfWrappedSkR changed in its GCM tag only (same key, iv and scalar). No client had written an envelope.
